clues: This city sits on the wide Danube River in the middle of Europe. Green woods and the first hills of the Alps rise at its edge.
Summers here are warm, with showers that come and go. Winters turn cold and dry, and snow falls less than it once did.
In 1804, this city became the capital of a brand new empire. It kept that rank for each state that rose from the empire later.
Mozart lived and worked in this city, and so did Beethoven. Their fame made it a top home of great music in Europe.
This city is the political heart of Austria. The leaders who run the whole land meet and work here.
